notes: HAMSTER (symbol HAMSTER) is a fixed-supply OpenZeppelin ERC-20 with 18 decimals, defined in src/HAMSTER.sol. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which is the launch factory. There is no owner, minter, pause, blacklist, burn, tax, fee-on-transfer, upgrade path or initialization step, so the supply can neither grow nor be moved by any privileged hand after launch and every launch flow (distributor transfer, pool seed, swaps) moves exactly what it says. The launch deploys no application contracts. Pool and economics are the launch's own: paired with IMD at 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 on Ethereum, 20% of the supply seeding the pool at a 5,000 IMD opening market cap derived by the deployer, and the remainder of the requester's share forwarded to 0x3ed212257958724579f13b3dba74a07ac6007903.
